cursorTrack.title: Cursor tracking
cursorTrack.description: Element rotates dynamically based on cursor position — the closer to an edge, the more it tilts toward you.

accordion.productionTitle: How do I create a production order?
accordion.productionContent: Navigate to Production > New Order, select the product from the catalog, specify quantity and due date, then click "Create." The order will appear in your production queue.
accordion.inventoryContent: Inventory updates automatically when production orders are completed or materials are consumed. You can view real-time stock levels in the Inventory dashboard and set low-stock alerts per item.
accordion.exportTitle: Can I export reports to Excel?
accordion.exportContent: Yes — every report page has an "Export" button in the top-right corner. You can export to CSV, XLSX, or PDF. Scheduled exports can be configured in Settings > Reports.
accordion.rolesTitle: How do I manage user roles?
accordion.rolesContent: Go to Settings > Team > Roles. You can create custom roles with granular permissions for each module. Changes take effect immediately for all users assigned to that role.

colors.label: Colors

colors.primaryDescription: Main brand color — buttons, active states, links
colors.secondaryDescription: Complementary brand color — highlights, badges, accents

colors.errorDescription: Critical issues — failed operations, urgent alerts
colors.informationDescription: General info — tips, neutral status updates
colors.surfacesDescription: Page and card backgrounds — solid color or gradient.
colors.backgroundDescription: Page background — tint to match warm or cool brand feel
colors.surfaceDescription: Cards and panels — slightly offset from background

typography.label: Typography
typography.description: Fonts, sizes, line height, and body weight
typography.allControls: Controls the font families, sizes, line height, and body weight across the entire interface.
typography.nonLatinNote: Non-Latin scripts (Arabic, Hindi, Chinese, Japanese, Korean) fall back to your device system font automatically.
typography.sampleBody: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

spacing.label: Spacing
spacing.description: Interface density — scales all padding and gaps
spacing.allControls: Scales all padding, gaps, and margins across the entire interface. Changes are visible in real time — try dragging this window over your page to compare.

buttons.label: Buttons
buttons.description: Shape, weight, shadow, and border of all button variants
buttons.allControls: All controls affect every button across the application simultaneously. Hover and click the preview buttons to see animations live.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.description: Radius, border, and label style of text inputs and fields
inputs.allControls: Controls the shape, border, focus ring, typography, and animation of text inputs, textareas, and search fields across the interface.

cards.label: Cards
cards.description: Shape, border, and shadow of cards and content panels
cards.allControls: Controls the appearance of all cards and panels — the primary content containers across the ERP interface.

badges.label: Badges
badges.description: Shape and weight of status badges, chips, and tags
badges.allControls: Controls the appearance of status badges, chips, and tags across the entire interface.

accordion.label: Accordion
accordion.description: Shape, spacing, and typography of collapsible sections
accordion.allControls: Controls the appearance of all accordion and collapsible sections across the interface — FAQ panels, detail drawers, and grouped settings.

alerts.label: Alerts
alerts.description: Inline alert banners and modal confirmation dialogs
alerts.allControls: Controls both inline alert banners and modal confirmation dialogs used for notifications, warnings, and destructive action confirmations.
alerts.inlineAlertsDescription: Status banners for success, warning, error, and info messages.
alerts.alertDialogDescription: Modal confirmation panels for destructive or critical actions.

autocomplete.label: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Dropdown popover and list items for search and combo fields
autocomplete.allControls: Controls the dropdown popover and list items for autocomplete and combo-box fields. The trigger inherits input token styling.

avatar.label: Avatar
avatar.description: Size, shape, border, and group overlap for user avatars
avatar.allControls: Controls the appearance of user avatars — profile pictures, fallback initials, status indicators, and grouped stacks.

breadcrumbs.label: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.description: Font, spacing, and separator style of navigation trails
breadcrumbs.allControls: Controls the appearance of breadcrumb navigation trails — from plain text links to tag/pill-style items with borders and backgrounds.

buttonGroup.label: Button Group
buttonGroup.description: Shape, gap, and border of connected button containers
buttonGroup.allControls: Controls the group container layout — gap, border, and shadow. Individual button appearance (radius, weight, color) is controlled by the Buttons module.

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.description: Shape, cell sizing, and typography of calendar panels and date pickers
calendar.allControls: Controls the container appearance of calendar panels and date pickers.

checkbox.label: Checkbox
checkbox.description: Size, shape, border, indicator, and label of checkbox controls
checkbox.allControls: Controls the appearance of all checkboxes — the control box, checkmark indicator, and label text across the entire interface.

checkboxGroup.label: Checkbox Group
checkboxGroup.description: Spacing, container shape, and label style of grouped checkboxes
checkboxGroup.allControls: Controls the container that wraps a group of related checkboxes — spacing, border, padding, and group label styling.

colorPicker.label: Color Picker
colorPicker.description: Popover, color area, sliders, thumbs, and swatch styling
colorPicker.allControls: Controls the appearance of color picker popover, color area, sliders, thumbs, and preset swatches across the interface.

comboBox.label: Combo Box
comboBox.description: Popover shape, trigger button, and list item styling
comboBox.allControls: Controls the appearance of combo box dropdowns — popover shape, trigger button, and list item styling.

datePicker.label: Date Picker
datePicker.description: Trigger, popover, and indicator of date picker fields
datePicker.allControls: Controls the trigger, popover, and indicator of date picker fields.

separator.label: Separator
separator.description: Thickness and shape of divider lines
separator.allControls: Controls the thickness and shape of divider lines.

skeleton.label: Skeleton
skeleton.description: Shape and animation speed of loading skeletons
skeleton.allControls: Controls the shape and animation speed of loading skeletons.

slider.label: Slider

slider.allControls: Controls the track, thumb, and animation of range sliders.

spinner.label: Spinner
spinner.description: Size and stroke width of loading spinners
spinner.allControls: Controls the size and stroke width of loading spinners.

tabs.label: Tabs
tabs.description: Tab list, items, active indicator, and panel padding
tabs.allControls: Controls the tab list, items, active indicator, and panel padding.
